name: Veterinary diet (cat)
definition: food formulated for a cat's health need and sold as a diet beside dry and wet.
notes: Cat food menu lists Veterinary Diets as its own category beside Wet and Dry.

name: Freeze-dried or air-dried cat food
definition: dehydrated raw or cooked food made for cats.
notes: Freeze-Dried Cat Food collection, 54 products; food form filter freeze-dried.

name: Lead rope
definition: a rope or strap with a clip or snap that is fixed to a headcollar to lead or tie up a horse.
notes: Leads is a subcategory of Halters & Leads; snap leads and rope leads listed.

name: Reins
definition: a pair of straps or a rope fixed to the bit or noseband, by which a rider or driver steers; sold apart from the bridle.
notes: Reins is its own subcategory under Bridles & Reins, beside Bridles & Nosebands.

name: Hive tool
definition: a flat steel lever with a scraper or hook end used to prise apart hive boxes and frames.
notes: Hive Tools category with economy, painted, comfort-grip, Italian, Turbo models.

name: Queen-rearing kit
definition: a cell-cup system (cups, cell plugs, holders and cell bars) sold as one kit to raise queen bees, with or without grafting.
notes: Single-product kit: cages, caps, cell cups, cell bars, grafting tool; Dadant EZI Queen System Complete too.

name: Queen cage
definition: a small cage in which a queen bee is introduced, shipped or marked.
notes: Plastic queen cages with candy tubes sold per cage; bulk tiers.

name: Grafting tool
definition: a fine spoon, needle or spring tool that lifts young larvae into queen cups.
notes: JZ-BZ Grafting Tool M00652 and Master Grafting Tool listed in queen-rearing group.

name: Cage-bird food
definition: seed mix, pellets, egg food, millet spray or treats made for pet cage and aviary birds; wild-bird food is B10.8.1.
notes: Bird Food & Treats category; seed, pellet and treat forms; wild-bird food separate.
